displayDescription: Pixel-art frame-by-frame study: a bulb idea charges, flashes and sparks into a connected node system on a dusk lake.
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (sole time owner) driving an explicit 12-drawings/sec exposure sheet
limitations: No Blender used per user instruction; scene is procedural Canvas 2D pixel art.
Drawings are procedurally authored per drawing index (33 distinct drawings on twos), not hand-drawn by an animator.
Water reflection is an approximated mirrored-slice effect, not optical simulation.
Title and HUD use an authored 5x7 bitmap font drawn into the canvas, not DOM text.
